name: Advanced Manufacturing & Defence
blurb: Home to BAE Systems' submarine build in Barrow and the Sellafield nuclear supply chain, needing welders, engineers and technicians from apprentice to doctorate level.

name: Construction
blurb: Building the homes, ports and infrastructure Cumbria needs, from St Cuthbert's Garden Village to the A66 upgrade, but short of trades at every level.

name: Energy & Net Zero
blurb: Nuclear, offshore wind and new clean energy projects around Sellafield, Moorside and the coast, needing engineers, welders and technicians for construction and operations.

name: Health & Social Care
blurb: Care homes, the NHS and community services need more people at every level, from entry-level care workers to nurses and social workers.

name: Land-based Industries
blurb: Farming, forestry and conservation across Cumbria's national parks and coastline, adapting to climate change and nature recovery.

name: Visitor Economy
blurb: Tourism and hospitality across the Lake District and beyond, needing chefs, front-of-house staff and managers who can keep visitors coming back.
